name: Dumbbell Standing External Rotation
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and lift your bent elbows out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to right angles with your forearms facing forward and your ribs over your hips.
Rotate your shoulders externally to pivot your forearms upward until they point vertically toward the ceiling.
Slowly rotate your forearms back down to the horizontal starting position under full control.
tips: Keep your elbows at shoulder height instead of letting them drop or drift backward.
Use very light dumbbells and avoid arching your lower back to gain extra range.
